surface.background: fully opaque dark technical substrate built as deep navy signal architecture
surface.alternate: charcoal-blue technical chamber using the same restrained luminous grammar
surface.finish: editorial cinematic product-visualization finish with matte physical depth and no cyberpunk spectacle

palette_roles.foundation: near-black navy based on #07111F fills the complete frame without transparency or crushed detail
palette_roles.module: muted blue-black based on #10263A defines substantial extruded modules and structural frames
palette_roles.normal_signal: electric cyan based on #27D8FF carries one dominant cyan route and any subordinate confirmed primary edges
palette_roles.active_state: acid green based on #B8FF3D appears only for the single active state or explicitly confirmed successful result
palette_roles.label: cool pale cyan-white based on #D8F7FF is reserved for deterministic overlay text

line_language.primary: one dominant cyan route moves through a small number of substantial modules with exact directional continuity
line_language.active: acid green only for the single active state, never as a general decorative second neon
line_language.boundaries: thick matte frames, recessed channels, and controlled seams replace HUD cards, city skylines, and random circuit wallpaper

material_and_texture.surface: matte anodized navy metal, dark ceramic, and restrained translucent inner membranes grounded on a fully opaque base
material_and_texture.modules: substantial extruded modules share one physical scale, bevel family, and shadow direction rather than floating as unrelated icons
material_and_texture.emission: cyan and acid-green light stays narrow, directional, and locally motivated with a soft emission halo no wider than six pixels at target size
material_and_texture.finish: low fine grain and precise edges preserve editorial tactility without glossy stock render polish

geometry.projection: front-oblique cutaway perspective with roughly fifteen degrees of elevation, stable verticals, and no isometric toy-city view
geometry.module_family: three to five substantial extruded modules form one coherent signal architecture with readable entrances, chambers, and exits
geometry.route: one continuous focal path crosses the system without decorative branches, loops, crossings, or duplicate destinations unless frozen semantics requires them
geometry.focal_rule: the active chamber or result is largest or brightest but never overwhelms route legibility or title-safe space

depth_and_camera.mode: restrained front-oblique cutaway perspective at medium-wide distance, closer to an editorial technical set than a dashboard
depth_and_camera.layers: foreground frame, working modules, and receding dark substrate create three readable depth bands
depth_and_camera.lighting: cool low-key ambient light reveals all module faces while cyan route emission and one acid-green active state provide the only luminous accents
depth_and_camera.atmosphere: minimal volumetric haze may separate depth but never hides an edge, port, arrow, node, or route

typography.voice: precise editorial Chinese headline with compact monospace English support applied through deterministic title overlay
typography.title_panel: title-safe negative space is an intentional dark architectural field rather than an empty black void
typography.exact_text: titles subtitles labels numbers and legends are rendered deterministically after image generation
typography.generated_text: the generated image remains text-free with no code terminal labels glyphs logos or watermark

density_and_spacing.density: medium-low system density with three to five large modules and one primary reading route
density_and_spacing.spacing: module gaps remain wide enough to expose route continuity and preserve one deterministic label or title field
density_and_spacing.occupancy: the signal architecture fills roughly seventy-two to eighty-four percent of the frame and never becomes a tiny object in a black canvas

required_traits: deep navy signal architecture reads as one complete physical system rather than a collection of floating UI cards
fully opaque dark technical substrate preserves readable structure and complete-frame occupancy
front-oblique cutaway perspective gives restrained depth without becoming isometric infrastructure or flat blueprint drafting
one dominant cyan route provides the primary reading order through substantial extruded modules
acid green only for the single active state or explicitly confirmed successful result
deterministic title overlay preserves exact language while the generated architecture remains text-free
forbidden_traits: no cyberpunk city skyline street alley vehicle human face character hacker or dramatic sci-fi narrative
no HUD dashboard code terminal random glyph microtext data rain or decorative interface wallpaper
no rainbow neon uncontrolled magenta violet-red palette multiple green focal points or glow around every object
no transparent background empty black field crushed module faces tiny isolated subject or clipped architecture
no glossy glass maze chrome machinery toy factory isometric server city flat blueprint drafting or white-background infographic
no invented modules branches arrows status lights labels metrics ports or system relationships beyond confirmed semantics

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 3 uses deep navy front-oblique signal architecture narrow cyan emission and one acid-green active state; Style 5 uses pale matte daylight fixed 30-degree isometric modules one amber journey and soft architectural shadows

Style 3 is technology-first with substantial dark modules and luminous system relationships; Style 6 is natural landscape-first with atmospheric terrain one journey one warm horizon and optional rear-view human scale
Style 3 uses extruded physical modules controlled emission and front-oblique cutaway depth; Style 4 uses flat orthographic linework construction marks and no luminous material depth
